Forge Your Warden

Name, likeness, and the discipline you'll lean on first.
Original keeps the artwork exactly as drawn. Recolor tints it with your skin tone, sigil color and gear.
Every stat starts at 4 and 9 more points fall where the dice send them (4 to 13 each, 25 in all). Roll until you like it — a warrior wants STR, a magician INT, an archer or pirate DEX, a thief LUK.

Key Settings
Drag a function onto a key, or click a function and then click (or press) the key you want. Drag a function off the keyboard, or hit its ×, to clear it. The arrow keys are fixed: ← → walk, ↑ ↓ climb ropes and ladders (↑ grabs one beside you, ↓ drops through a foothold). Jump + ←/→ hops off a rope.
